title: Parcel cancelled
description: Proposal for team review. Published to the swiftdrop.parcel-pricing topic exchange, routing key parcel.cancelled, after a customer cancellation is committed. A booking can be cancelled only while its status is BOOKED (no courier scheduled yet). Consumers: Tracking & Reporting shows CANCELLED on the public timeline; Delivery Operations must not schedule the parcel; Payment & Settlement refunds refundAmount to paymentId for ONLINE bookings. customerUserId, paymentId and the amounts are internal and must not be shown on public tracking.

parcelId.description: Parcel identifier assigned by Parcel & Pricing (the bookingId used by Payment)

publicDescription.description: Customer-safe timeline text without personal data

customerUserId.description: Identity user id of the customer who made and cancelled the booking

paymentId.description: Payment & Settlement payment to refund. Present for paid ONLINE bookings.

cancellationFee.description: LKR kept as a cancellation fee. Always 0 for COD.

refundAmount.description: LKR to refund to the original payment method. 0 when nothing was paid.
